title: 模拟一 · 构词与临床信息识别

questions.stem: Which term contains a suffix meaning enlargement rather than inflammation?
questions.explanation: megaly表示增大，其他选项含itis表示炎症。

questions.stem: A note says that the cause is possible. Which revision retains that certainty?
options: The finding may reflect the condition
questions.explanation: may保留可能性，其他改变确定程度或方向。

questions.stem: Which noun correctly completes These ___ were reviewed?
questions.explanation: these与were要求复数名词diagnoses。

questions.stem: A lesion distal to the knee lies in which direction?
options: Deeper beneath the skin by definition
Closer to the midline by definition
Farther along the limb away from its attachment
Closer to the trunk than the knee
questions.explanation: distal描述肢体远端，不等于深或内侧。

questions.stem: Which phrase describes a patient-reported symptom rather than an observed sign?
options: The pulse is counted as rapid
questions.explanation: 恶心是主观感受，其余为观察测量。

questions.stem: Which term means removal rather than creation of an opening?
questions.explanation: ectomy表示切除，ostomy表示造口。

questions.stem: Which sentence correctly distinguishes artery from vein?
options: Both are defined only by oxygen content
An artery carries blood away from the heart
An artery always carries oxygen-rich blood
A vein always carries oxygen-poor blood
questions.explanation: 按血流相对心脏方向命名。

questions.stem: Which result is a description of morphology rather than a cause?
options: Confirmed iron loss from an identified lesion
questions.explanation: microcytic描述细胞大小，不确定病因。

questions.stem: Which change would incorrectly increase certainty?
questions.explanation: confirms强于suggests。

questions.stem: Which description distinguishes dysphagia from odynophagia?
options: Difficulty swallowing versus pain on swallowing
questions.explanation: 吞咽困难与吞咽痛应区分。

questions.stem:
Case A. A patient reports cough for six days. The temperature is measured as elevated, and a chest image shows a focal opacity. No microbiological result is available. The clinician considers pneumonia and arranges further assessment.

Which item is a subjective report?
questions.explanation: 咳嗽由患者陈述，其他已有客观或未提供信息。

questions.stem: In Case A, which conclusion is premature?
options: A specific bacterium has been identified
questions.explanation: 没有病原学结果，不能确定具体细菌。

questions.stem: In Case A, what does focal opacity belong to?
questions.explanation: opacity为影像描述。

questions.stem: In Case A, what duration is provided?
questions.explanation: 原文明确咳嗽六天。

questions.stem: In Case A, which summary preserves the status?
options: Pneumonia is being considered with further assessment planned
questions.explanation: 应保留初步考虑及待评估。

questions.stem:
Case B. A medicine list contains a drug name and dose but no frequency. The patient owns two formulations. A pharmacist asks the prescriber to clarify the instruction and then asks the patient to explain the revised plan back.

What is missing initially?
questions.explanation: 原文明确缺少频次。

questions.stem: In Case B, why avoid guessing from the product name?
options: The name alone does not define the full schedule
questions.explanation: 药名不足以确定用法。

questions.stem: In Case B, what is the purpose of explaining the plan back?
questions.explanation: 复述帮助核对理解。

questions.stem: In Case B, why do formulations matter?
options: They remove the need to verify frequency
They always have the same route
questions.explanation: 剂型可影响使用说明。

questions.stem: In Case B, which statement reflects the correct sequence?
options: The old incomplete instruction is ignored without checking
Clarification precedes advice based on the revised instruction
A frequency is guessed before clarification
questions.explanation: 先核实再基于完整说明指导。

title: 模拟二 · 心肺与消化病例

questions.stem: Which observation most directly describes orthopnea?
options: The pulse is irregular without symptoms
questions.explanation: orthopnea为平卧时呼吸困难。

questions.stem: What does an elevated troponin establish most directly when appropriately interpreted?
options: A coronary thrombus in every case
questions.explanation: 心肌损伤与梗死病因需区分。

questions.stem: Which statement about preserved ejection fraction is accurate?
options: It does not by itself exclude heart failure
It proves all cardiac function is normal
It excludes every cause of breathlessness
It means no assessment is needed
questions.explanation: 射血分数保留不能单独排除心衰。

questions.stem: Which concept differs from oxygenation?
options: Ventilation, which concerns movement of air
Oxygen saturation as a measure of oxygen binding
questions.explanation: 通气关注空气进出，与氧合不同。

questions.stem: Which term describes blood coughed from the respiratory tract?
questions.explanation: hemoptysis为咯血。

questions.stem: Which feature should be retained when translating episodic symptoms?
questions.explanation: episodic需保留间歇性。

questions.stem: Which organ produces bile that is stored in the gallbladder?

questions.stem: What does portal hypertension help explain in the appropriate setting?
questions.explanation: 门静脉高压与静脉曲张及腹水相关。

questions.stem: Which finding is most directly about hepatocellular injury rather than a complete function assessment?
options: A complete assessment of synthetic function
questions.explanation: 氨基转移酶反映损伤线索。

questions.stem: Which phrase would preserve a planned investigation?
questions.explanation: 安排中不等于已有结果。

questions.stem:
Case C. A man develops exertional chest pressure that now occurs more often than before. No current ECG or biomarker result is provided. His clinician arranges prompt evaluation and asks about the timing, duration, and associated symptoms.

Which change increases concern?
questions.explanation: 频率增加为病史变化。

questions.stem: In Case C, what is not available?
questions.explanation: 没有当前心电或标志物结果。

questions.stem: In Case C, which wording is justified?
options: The patient has no relevant symptoms
The symptoms raise concern and require assessment
questions.explanation: 应保留疑虑及待评估。

questions.stem: In Case C, why record duration separately from frequency?
options: They describe different dimensions of the episodes
questions.explanation: 持续时间与频率不同。

questions.stem: In Case C, which added detail would be fabricated?
questions.explanation: 未给具体化验数值。

questions.stem:
Case D. A patient with known cirrhosis develops dark tarry stool and lightheadedness. Varices were found in the past, but no current endoscopy has been performed. The team assesses circulation while investigating the source.

Which source statement is most accurate?
options: The current source remains to be established
Varices are definitely the source because of history
questions.explanation: 既往病变不确证本次来源。

questions.stem: In Case D, which symptom adds physiological concern?
options: Only the date of old endoscopy
questions.explanation: 头晕需结合循环状态评估。

questions.stem: In Case D, what does tarry stool suggest?
questions.explanation: 黑粪提示消化道出血线索而非绝对定位。

questions.stem: In Case D, what happens while the source is investigated?
questions.explanation: 定位和循环评估同步进行。

questions.stem: In Case D, why retain previously found when mentioning varices?
options: It distinguishes historical findings from current evidence
questions.explanation: 过去与现在证据需分开。

translations.source: Although the ejection fraction is preserved, the symptoms still require a complete cardiac assessment.
translations.reference: 虽然射血分数保留，这些症状仍需完整心脏评估。

options: Frequency versus a guaranteed infection diagnosis only
Urine versus all blood chemistry as identical
questions.explanation: 尿频与多尿不能混用。

questions.stem: Which information best establishes a recent renal change?
options: A reliable recent baseline compared with the current result
questions.explanation: 近期基线比较提供时间信息。

questions.stem: Which urinary finding complements an estimate of filtration?
questions.explanation: 尿白蛋白提供肾损伤维度。

questions.stem: What does hyperplasia primarily describe?

questions.stem: Which combination most supports iron deficiency in the supplied options?

Only elevated reticulocytes with hemolysis markers

questions.stem: Which symptom is relevant to vitamin B12 deficiency assessment?

questions.explanation: B12缺乏可有神经表现。

questions.stem: Which statement about ferritin is accurate?
options: It determines every anemia cause alone
questions.explanation: 铁蛋白受铁储备及炎症影响。

questions.stem: What does a reticulocyte response concern?

questions.stem: Which limitation applies to glycated hemoglobin interpretation?
options: Red cell-related factors may affect it
It is always unaffected by anemia
It measures only the last minute

questions.stem: Which pairing reflects an endocrine feedback relationship?
questions.explanation: TSH与甲状腺激素属于反馈轴相关指标。

questions.stem:
Case E. A patient has vomiting, reduced urine output, and a creatinine rise from a result obtained five days earlier. Medicines and possible obstruction are being reviewed. No cause has been established definitively.

What supports an acute change?
questions.explanation: 可靠近期比较支持急性变化。

questions.stem: In Case E, why is volume depletion considered?

questions.explanation: 呕吐提供容量不足线索。

questions.stem: In Case E, which statement is too strong?
questions.explanation: 单因结论超出资料。

questions.stem: In Case E, what could obstruction affect?
questions.explanation: 梗阻可影响尿液排出。

questions.stem: In Case E, what should remain in the summary?
options: The change, timing, and uncertainty of cause
questions.explanation: 时间与病因未定均需保留。

questions.stem:
Case F. A patient using insulin misses a meal and becomes sweaty and confused. Glucose is low during the symptoms, which improve after correction. The clinician reviews daily patterns rather than relying solely on a favorable long-term average.

Which temporal relation is documented?
options: Low glucose was measured during symptoms
Low glucose occurred only years earlier
Symptoms preceded the first insulin prescription by decades
questions.explanation: 测量与症状同时发生。

questions.stem: In Case F, what improves after correction?
questions.explanation: 只明确症状改善。

questions.stem: In Case F, why is the long-term average insufficient?
options: It proves every daily value is normal
It can conceal brief low-glucose episodes
questions.explanation: 平均值不能代表每次波动。

questions.stem: In Case F, what should be reviewed to prevent recurrence?
options: Actual dosing, meals, activity, and relevant clinical changes
questions.explanation: 具体情境影响风险。

questions.stem: In Case F, which term describes the documented low glucose state?
questions.explanation: 低血糖为hypoglycemia。

translations.source: The current creatinine should be compared with previous values before the duration of dysfunction is assigned.

questions.stem: Which wording best preserves a noncausal observational result?

The exposure necessarily caused the outcome
Every exposed participant developed the outcome
All confounding was eliminated by definition
questions.explanation: associated with表达关联而非证明因果。

questions.stem: What does residual confounding cannot be excluded mean?

questions.stem: Which distinction separates cancer stage from grade?

questions.stem: Which information is crucial when deficits are discovered on waking?

questions.explanation: 最后正常时间与发现时间分开。

questions.stem: Which claim about a positive screening test is safest?
options: Its meaning depends on test properties and clinical context

questions.stem:
Case G. A patient with heart failure and kidney disease reports less breathlessness after treatment, but now feels dizzy on standing. Blood pressure, kidney function, and electrolytes are being reviewed. The clinician has not yet changed the dose.

Which summary captures both sides?
options: Treatment provided no benefit at all
The dose has already been reduced
Symptoms improved, but a new concern requires review
Treatment was wholly successful with no concern
questions.explanation: 既有改善又有新问题。

questions.stem: In Case G, what is still pending?
options: The decision about changing the dose
questions.explanation: 尚未调整剂量。

questions.stem: In Case G, why assess multiple measures?
options: Benefit and harm cannot be judged from one symptom alone
A single symptom answers every question
Electrolytes are unrelated to all treatment
questions.explanation: 整体评估需多个维度。

questions.stem: In Case G, what does on standing modify?
questions.explanation: 体位限定头晕发生。

questions.stem: In Case G, which invented statement should be rejected?
options: The dose was reduced by a specified amount
questions.explanation: 未提供任何剂量调整。

questions.stem:
Case H. A cohort report finds an adjusted association between sleep symptoms and a later cardiovascular outcome. The authors note residual confounding and measurement limitations. A clinician asks whether the result proves that treating the symptom will prevent disease. The report contains no treatment trial.

What study design is described?
questions.explanation: 报告为观察性队列。

questions.stem: In Case H, what inference exceeds the report?
options: Treating the symptom is proven to prevent disease
questions.explanation: 观察关联不能证明治疗获益。

questions.stem: In Case H, why retain measurement limitations?
options: They affect interpretation of the reported association
They prove all results are false
questions.explanation: 测量局限影响结果解释。

questions.stem: In Case H, what is not included?
questions.explanation: 原文明确无治疗试验。

questions.stem: In Case H, which response is most defensible?
options: Every sleep symptom is the same disease
The result motivates further study but does not establish treatment efficacy
questions.explanation: 应区分研究启发与治疗确证。
